g.text: Hip tension horn: the fit over the full 90–270° travel

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #738694

g.text: Sample A · L₂ = L₃ = 300 mm · q_ab = 2 · α = 0° · F_z = 98.1 N · zero moving mass
Positive support balances an upward wheel load: the spring acts downward on the wheel. Above 246.874° it acts upward instead.
Endpoints are undefined ratios, not infinite spring forces. Full-range peak tension ≈1.60 kN. No travel, strength or shock rating is assumed.
